About.title: About QuemLeva
About.intro: QuemLeva sorts out who brings what to barbecues, lunches, birthdays and holiday parties. It is free, needs no sign-up and is open source.

safety.title: How to tell it is safe
safety.p1: QuemLeva only asks for your name. It never asks for a password, verification code, phone number, ID number, card details or payment. If a page asks for any of that, it is not QuemLeva.
safety.p2: The link comes from someone in your group. If in doubt, ask whoever sent it before opening it.

who.title: Who makes it
who.p1: QuemLeva is an independent project, made in Brazil and maintained by {operator}.

code.title: Open source
code.p1: The code is open source under the AGPL-3.0 license, and anyone can check how it works <repo>on GitHub</repo>.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains, in plain words, what data QuemLeva keeps, why and for how long. QuemLeva has no accounts and does not sell or share data for advertising.

collect.title: What we keep
collect.p1: The event details the organizer writes: name, date, time, place, notes, number of adults and kids, and the list of items.
collect.p2: The name each person writes when joining, their RSVP, plus-ones, what they picked to bring, notes and amounts spent, when given.
collect.p3: A random device code that recognizes you in the event without an account. It also lets us count, without identifying anyone, how many organizers come back to create events.
collect.p4: To prevent abuse, we log event creation with a scrambled version (hash) of the IP address. That log is deleted within 1 day.

visibility.title: Who sees what
visibility.p1: Anyone with the event link sees the list, participant names, RSVPs, who brings each item and the amounts given. So share the link only with your group.
visibility.p2: The organizer link lets you edit the event. Keep it to yourself.

device.title: On your device
device.p1: Your browser stores the device code, organizer links and the "My events" list, plus a cookie with your chosen language. We use no advertising or tracking cookies.

providers.title: Services we use
providers.p1: Supabase (database, with servers in São Paulo) and Vercel (website hosting). They process data only to run QuemLeva and may keep technical access logs, such as IP addresses, under their own policies.
providers.p2: If the organizer uses Spliit to split costs, whatever they take there follows Spliit's rules.

retention.title: How long
retention.p1: Events are kept while QuemLeva is online, so links keep working. You can ask for deletion at any time.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or a whole event. Write to the contact below and include the event link.
rights.p2: In the app itself, you can change your name by joining again, and the organizer can remove participants.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.p1: The data controller is {operator}. If this policy changes, the date at the top is updated.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: By using QuemLeva, you agree to these terms.

service.title: The service
service.p1: QuemLeva is free and provided as is, with no guarantee that it will always work or be error-free. It may change or shut down; whenever possible, we will give notice first.

content.title: What you write
content.p1: You are responsible for what you write in an event. Do not use QuemLeva for illegal, offensive or misleading content, or for spam. We may remove events that break these rules.

links.title: Links
links.p1: Anyone with the event link can see the list and take part. Be careful where you share it, and do not share the organizer link.

payments.title: Payments
payments.p1: QuemLeva does not receive or handle payments. Amounts and settling up are arranged among yourselves.

license.title: Open source
license.p1: QuemLeva's code is under the AGPL-3.0 license.

law.title: Governing law
law.p1: These terms are governed by the laws of Brazil.
